label: Figure 9.3: Measures to promote vaccination (positive externality of consumption)
alt: Vaccine market showing a subsidy shifting MSC down to MSC plus subsidy and a campaign shifting MPB right, both reaching Q*.
caption: Starting from Figure 9.2, two policies push output from Q1 = 55 up to the efficient Q* = 75 thousand doses. 1. Subsidy: an $8 per-dose subsidy shifts supply down to MSC + subsidy, which cuts MPB at Q*, so patients pay only P2 = $11 (below P1 = $15). 2. Awareness campaign: raises private valuation, shifting MPB to the right towards MSB so it now meets the original MSC at Q*.
